title: DevOps Engineer
description:
We're working with a leading energy network operator driving the energy transition in a major European city. Join a team dedicated to building and operating critical infrastructure for a sustainable future, leveraging cutting\-edge digital and AI solutions.
   

  

 The Role
   

  

* Develop, operate, and enhance Azure platform and AI solutions to support innovative digital and AI applications.
* Define and design secure, scalable, and cost\-effective Azure target architectures, governance, and security structures.
* Conceptualise and manage central cost control for the Azure platform to ensure transparency and manageability of resources.
* Continuously develop, operate, and optimise CI/CD pipelines, Infrastructure as Code using Terraform, templates, and reference solutions.
* Advise and support IT platform and project teams on Azure AI use cases and platform architectures.
* Ensure the secure operation and continuous development of Azure AI Services like Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, Cognitive Services, and AI Search.


 What You'll Need
   

  

* Completed degree in Computer Science, Data Science, Mathematics, or a comparable qualification, with relevant Azure experience.
* Proficiency in Azure DevOps, Git, Terraform, Entra ID, Key Vault, Private Endpoints, Networking, Landing Zones, and Monitoring.
* Proven experience in designing, developing, and maintaining Infrastructure as Code projects for Azure resource deployment with Terraform and Azure DevOps.
* Demonstrable practical experience with the Microsoft Azure AI Stack, including Azure OpenAI, AI Foundry, Cognitive Services, and AI Search.
* Structured, planning, and conceptual approach combined with the ability to pragmatically implement solutions in operational environments.
* Independent, self\-reliant work style, strong teamwork skills, and clear, target\-group\-oriented communication.


 What's On Offer
   

  

* Contribute to the energy transition and shaping the future of a major city.
* Work with advanced Azure platform and AI technologies.
* Opportunity for continuous learning and development in AI and cloud solutions.
* Collaborative and supportive team environment.


 Apply via Haystack today!
